data.narrative:
Arena AI is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Pratap Ranade and Engin Ural that has raised $62M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 10 comparables—2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $118M. Peer-median analysis examines six same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.1B, ranging from $300M to $3.0B. This wider dispersion reflects heterogeneity within the defense AI market at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $100M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $621M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty regarding Arena AI's relative market position and growth trajectory within a peer set that spans from pre-unicorn to established unicorn status. Stage-progression yields the conservative bound, while peer-median dominates the upper range. Without visibility into Arena AI's revenue scale, unit economics, or customer concentration relative to named peers, the median estimate ($621M) represents the most defensible point in this range, though substantial downside and upside scenarios remain plausible.
